aboutGame.title: What is SAW Genesis?
paragraphs: SAW Genesis is a 3v1 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game from Bloober Team that takes the SAW franchise back to 1920s London, decades before John Kramer's trials. One player becomes the Judge, an early architect of the philosophy that would become Jigsaw, while three Accused players work together to solve trials, survive traps, and escape a maze that reshuffles every match.

Instead of a modern industrial basement, SAW Genesis unfolds in the grim aftermath of World War I, where crude steam-driven traps and permanent injuries turn every choice into a life-or-limb decision. Our SAW Genesis Wiki covers the roles, trap survival tactics, story, platforms, and release updates with free guides built from confirmed details.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about SAW Genesis.

items.question: What is SAW Genesis?
items.answer: SAW Genesis is a 3v1 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game from Bloober Team set in 1920s London. One player controls the Judge and the trial's traps, while three Accused players cooperate to solve challenges, collect keys, and escape the maze.

items.question: When does SAW Genesis release?
items.answer: SAW Genesis is targeting Steam Early Access in Q1 2027. Bloober Team moved the window from 2026 to give the game more development time, and a full release is expected after roughly a year of Early Access.

items.question: How many players does SAW Genesis support?
items.answer: Every SAW Genesis match is a 3v1 trial: three Accused players against one Judge, for four players in total. The maps are procedurally generated, so the layout changes between matches.

items.question: Can you play SAW Genesis solo?
items.answer: SAW Genesis is built around online multiplayer, and there is no confirmed single-player mode. The 3v1 structure depends on three Accused coordinating against a live Judge.

items.question: Is SAW Genesis crossplay?
items.answer: Crossplay has not been confirmed for SAW Genesis. The game is announced for PC through Steam, and the developers have not promised cross-platform matchmaking or cross-progression.

items.question: What platforms is SAW Genesis on?
items.answer: SAW Genesis is confirmed for PC through Steam Early Access, with console versions and a final release date still to be announced.
